source: I don't trust someone who changes their story every time.
target: Trust is built on consistency. A story that changes with every telling deserves none.
references: Trust is built on consistency. A story that changes with every telling deserves none.
source_meaning: I don't trust someone who changes their story every time.

source: Help chahiye? Toh complete picture do. Missing details mujhe pasand nahi.
target: Truth is the price of my help. Bring me the whole of it, not a convenient fragment.
references: Truth is the price of my help. Bring me the whole of it, not a convenient fragment.
source_meaning: If you want my help, tell me the whole truth.

source: You promised you would be here, and you weren't.
target: You gave your word and failed to appear. I remember both the promise and the absence.
references: You gave your word and failed to appear. I remember both the promise and the absence.
source_meaning: You promised you would be here, and you weren't.

source: Decision abhi nahi. Mujhe sochne do; jaldi karna zaroori nahi, sahi hona zaroori hai.
target: This decision will shape what follows. I will consider it before I move.
references: This decision will shape what follows. I will consider it before I move.
source_meaning: I need time to think before I make this decision.

source: Don't mistake my silence for agreement.
target: Silence is not surrender, nor is it consent. Do not mistake one for the other.
references: Silence is not surrender, nor is it consent. Do not mistake one for the other.
source_meaning: Don't mistake my silence for agreement.

source: Disagree kar sakte hain. Scene create karna optional hai.
target: Disagreement need not become conflict. There is enough ruin in the world already.
references: Disagreement need not become conflict. There is enough ruin in the world already.
source_meaning: We can disagree without turning this into a fight.

source: I made a mistake, and I will take responsibility for it.
target: I made the error. I will answer for it; responsibility cannot be passed to another.
references: I made the error. I will answer for it; responsibility cannot be passed to another.
source_meaning: I made a mistake, and I will take responsibility for it.

source: Situation tough hai. Loyalty ka test bhi wahi hota hai.
target: Hardship reveals loyalty. I will not abandon someone merely because the path has grown difficult.
references: Hardship reveals loyalty. I will not abandon someone merely because the path has grown difficult.
source_meaning: I won't abandon someone just because things got difficult.

source: The evidence doesn't support what you're claiming.
target: Claims do not become facts through repetition. The evidence does not support yours.
references: Claims do not become facts through repetition. The evidence does not support yours.
source_meaning: The evidence doesn't support what you're claiming.

source: Pehle sabko bolne do. Phir decide karenge kis direction mein jaana hai.
target: Let every voice be heard before we choose our course. A rushed decision can waste a rare chance.
references: Let every voice be heard before we choose our course. A rushed decision can waste a rare chance.
source_meaning: Let's hear everyone before we choose a direction.

source: I can forgive you, but rebuilding trust will take time.
target: Forgiveness may begin today. Trust must be rebuilt through time and action.
references: Forgiveness may begin today. Trust must be rebuilt through time and action.
source_meaning: I can forgive you, but rebuilding trust will take time.

source: Promise cheap hai. Usse poora karna costly. Soch kar bolna.
target: A promise made without intent is only a tool of deception. Do not offer one you will not keep.
references: A promise made without intent is only a tool of deception. Do not offer one you will not keep.
source_meaning: Don't make a promise unless you intend to keep it.

source: I understand why you're angry, but threatening people won't solve it.
target: Anger may be justified, but threats solve nothing. Choose a method that changes the outcome.
references: Anger may be justified, but threats solve nothing. Choose a method that changes the outcome.
source_meaning: I understand why you're angry, but threatening people won't solve it.

source: One shot hai. Details check karo. Surprise sirf doosron ke liye hona chahiye.
target: We have one opportunity to make this right. Prepare as though there will be no second.
references: We have one opportunity to make this right. Prepare as though there will be no second.
source_meaning: We have one chance to get this right, so prepare carefully.

source: I would rather hear an uncomfortable truth than a comforting lie.
target: An unpleasant truth is more useful than a beautiful lie. I will take the truth.
references: An unpleasant truth is more useful than a beautiful lie. I will take the truth.
source_meaning: I would rather hear an uncomfortable truth than a comforting lie.

source: Sab kuch aaj solve karna zaroori nahi. Priority set karo.
target: Not every burden must be carried today. Even decisive action requires timing.
references: Not every burden must be carried today. Even decisive action requires timing.
source_meaning: You don't have to solve everything today.

source: If the plan fails, we need a backup ready.
target: When one path fails, another must remain. Prepare the alternative before it is needed.
references: When one path fails, another must remain. Prepare the alternative before it is needed.
source_meaning: If the plan fails, we need a backup ready.

source: Fear ko information samjho, decision-maker nahi.
target: Fear may speak, but it will not decide for me.
references: Fear may speak, but it will not decide for me.
source_meaning: I won't let fear make this decision for me.

source: The team needs a clear answer, not another delay.
target: The team needs a clear answer. Another delay will only deepen the uncertainty.
references: The team needs a clear answer. Another delay will only deepen the uncertainty.
source_meaning: The team needs a clear answer, not another delay.

source: Listen karna aur reply prepare karna alag cheezein hain. Pehla try karo.
target: Listen to understand, not merely to prepare your reply. A conversation is not a contest for the last word.
references: Listen to understand, not merely to prepare your reply. A conversation is not a contest for the last word.
source_meaning: I need you to listen, not just wait for your turn to speak.

source: I won't sign anything I haven't read carefully.
target: I will not sign what I have not examined. A mark on a page can bind more than its author expects.
references: I will not sign what I have not examined. A mark on a page can bind more than its author expects.
source_meaning: I won't sign anything I haven't read carefully.

source: Past ek record hai, final verdict nahi. Agla move tumhare haath mein hai.
target: The past explains a beginning; it does not have to command the ending.
references: The past explains a beginning; it does not have to command the ending.
source_meaning: Your past doesn't have to decide your future.

source: We should check the facts before blaming anyone.
target: Examine the facts before assigning blame. An accusation made too early can become its own injustice.
references: Examine the facts before assigning blame. An accusation made too early can become its own injustice.
source_meaning: We should check the facts before blaming anyone.

source: Difficult hona issue nahi. Dishonest hona hai.
target: A difficult person can still be trusted when honesty remains. Deception is the true obstacle.
references: A difficult person can still be trusted when honesty remains. Deception is the true obstacle.
source_meaning: I can work with a difficult person if they are honest.

source: I need a clear boundary, and I need you to respect it.
target: A boundary has been set. Respect it; clarity should not need to be repeated.
references: A boundary has been set. Respect it; clarity should not need to be repeated.
source_meaning: I need a clear boundary, and I need you to respect it.

source: Confidence useful hai. Certainty ka drama mat karo.
target: Confidence is a belief. Certainty is a claim. Do not confuse the two.
references: Confidence is a belief. Certainty is a claim. Do not confuse the two.
source_meaning: We should not confuse confidence with certainty.

source: If you need to change the plan, tell me early.
target: If the plan must change, tell me before the moment is lost.
references: If the plan must change, tell me before the moment is lost.
source_meaning: If you need to change the plan, tell me early.

source: Compliments noted. Problem abhi bhi wahin hai.
target: Do not offer praise while the failure remains. Repair the problem.
references: Do not offer praise while the failure remains. Repair the problem.
source_meaning: I don't want praise; I want the problem fixed.

source: We need to protect the people who depend on us.
target: Those who depend on us must not be left exposed. Their safety is part of our duty.
references: Those who depend on us must not be left exposed. Their safety is part of our duty.
source_meaning: We need to protect the people who depend on us.

source: Fast answer impressive lagta hai. Wrong direction expensive padti hai.
target: A fast answer that leads us astray is merely a quicker route to failure.
references: A fast answer that leads us astray is merely a quicker route to failure.
source_meaning: A quick answer is useless if it sends us in the wrong direction.

source: I need proof that this will work before I approve it.
target: Show me evidence that the plan works. Approval without proof is a gamble I will not make.
references: Show me evidence that the plan works. Approval without proof is a gamble I will not make.
source_meaning: I need proof that this will work before I approve it.

source: One mistake, one owner. Collective punishment se problem solve nahi hoti.
target: One person's error does not justify condemning the entire team. Judgment must be measured.
references: One person's error does not justify condemning the entire team. Judgment must be measured.
source_meaning: Don't punish the whole team for one person's mistake.

source: I am willing to start again, but not pretend nothing happened.
target: I will begin again, but I will not erase what happened. A new start is not amnesia.
references: I will begin again, but I will not erase what happened. A new start is not amnesia.
source_meaning: I am willing to start again, but not pretend nothing happened.

source: Help lena weakness nahi. Control apne paas rakhna hai toh terms clear rakho.
target: Seeking help is not surrender. You may accept support and still keep command of your choices.
references: Seeking help is not surrender. You may accept support and still keep command of your choices.
source_meaning: You can ask for help without giving up control.

source: I won't let one bad day define the entire project.
target: One poor day will not define the whole undertaking. The work must be judged by its full course.
references: One poor day will not define the whole undertaking. The work must be judged by its full course.
source_meaning: I won't let one bad day define the entire project.

source: Risk ko hide karoge toh control nahi, surprise milega.
target: A hidden risk cannot be controlled. Bring it into the light while there is still time to act.
references: A hidden risk cannot be controlled. Bring it into the light while there is still time to act.
source_meaning: If we hide the risk, we cannot manage it.

source: I respect your experience, but we still need to test the idea.
target: Experience earns respect, not immunity from testing. Let the idea prove its worth.
references: Experience earns respect, not immunity from testing. Let the idea prove its worth.
source_meaning: I respect your experience, but we still need to test the idea.

source: Aaj decision chahiye. No bhi acceptable hai; uncertainty nahi.
target: The decision is needed today. A refusal is still an answer, and uncertainty cannot rule forever.
references: The decision is needed today. A refusal is still an answer, and uncertainty cannot rule forever.
source_meaning: I need a decision today, even if the answer is no.

source: I know the task is difficult, but we can break it into smaller steps.
target: The task is difficult, not indivisible. Break it into steps, then take the first.
references: The task is difficult, not indivisible. Break it into steps, then take the first.
source_meaning: I know the task is difficult, but we can break it into smaller steps.

source: Unsure ho toh disclose karo. Guess ko fact bana kar mat becho.
target: Say when you do not know. A guess dressed as certainty can lead everyone into ruin.
references: Say when you do not know. A guess dressed as certainty can lead everyone into ruin.
source_meaning: I need you to tell me when you are unsure instead of guessing.

source: I never said I would pay for it.
target: Payment was never my commitment. Do not assign me an obligation I did not accept.
references: Payment was never my commitment. Do not assign me an obligation I did not accept.
source_meaning: I never said I would pay for it.

source: Report ready ho, tab call karna. Usse pehle nahi.
target: Call when the report is ready. Before then, there is nothing useful to discuss.
references: Call when the report is ready. Before then, there is nothing useful to discuss.
source_meaning: Call me once the report is ready, not before.

source: The meeting moved from Tuesday to Thursday at 4 pm.
target: The meeting is now Thursday at four in the afternoon, not Tuesday. Adjust your plans accordingly.
references: The meeting is now Thursday at four in the afternoon, not Tuesday. Adjust your plans accordingly.
source_meaning: The meeting moved from Tuesday to Thursday at 4 pm.

source: Ravi ko bata do: keys Meera ke paas hain.
target: Tell Ravi that Meera holds the keys. Let the message be clear and complete.
references: Tell Ravi that Meera holds the keys. Let the message be clear and complete.
source_meaning: Tell Ravi the keys are with Meera.

source: Did anyone check the second invoice?
target: Has anyone examined the second invoice? An overlooked detail can become an expensive mistake.
references: Has anyone examined the second invoice? An overlooked detail can become an expensive mistake.
source_meaning: Did anyone check the second invoice?

source: Photos aaj raat bhej dena.
target: Send the photographs tonight. The deadline is simple; there is no need to complicate it.
references: Send the photographs tonight. The deadline is simple; there is no need to complicate it.
source_meaning: Please send me the photos tonight.

source: I am sorry I missed your call; I was on the train.
target: I missed your call because I was on the train. That is the reason, nothing more.
references: I missed your call because I was on the train. That is the reason, nothing more.
source_meaning: I am sorry I missed your call; I was on the train.

source: Neha ki appointment khatam ho jaaye, uske baad nikal sakte hain.
target: We may leave once Neha's appointment has ended. Until then, we wait.
references: We may leave once Neha's appointment has ended. Until then, we wait.
source_meaning: We can leave after Neha finishes her appointment.

source: Don't send the package until I confirm the address.
target: Do not send the package until I confirm the address. One careless move can send it beyond reach.
references: Do not send the package until I confirm the address. One careless move can send it beyond reach.
source_meaning: Don't send the package until I confirm the address.

source: Shop 8 baje band hoti hai. Humein 7:30 tak nikalna hoga.
target: The shop closes at eight. We leave by seven-thirty, or we accept the consequence of arriving too late.
references: The shop closes at eight. We leave by seven-thirty, or we accept the consequence of arriving too late.
source_meaning: The shop closes at 8, so we need to leave by 7:30.

source: I ordered two blue shirts, not three black ones.
target: Two blue shirts were ordered, not three black ones. Precision is not a luxury.
references: Two blue shirts were ordered, not three black ones. Precision is not a luxury.
source_meaning: I ordered two blue shirts, not three black ones.

source: Baarish nahi ruki toh match late shuru hoga.
target: The match will begin late unless the rain stops. The weather has the final say for now.
references: The match will begin late unless the rain stops. The weather has the final say for now.
source_meaning: Unless the rain stops, the match will start late.

source: I have already paid the electricity bill for October.
target: October's electricity bill has already been paid. There is no debt left to settle on that account.
references: October's electricity bill has already been paid. There is no debt left to settle on that account.
source_meaning: I have already paid the electricity bill for October.

source: Dad ko subah 6 baje se pehle mat jagana.
target: Do not wake Dad before six in the morning. Even urgency has its proper hour.
references: Do not wake Dad before six in the morning. Even urgency has its proper hour.
source_meaning: Please don't wake Dad before 6 am.

source: I can pick up Asha at 5:15 if the bus is on time.
target: If the bus arrives on time, I can collect Asha at five-fifteen. The condition matters.
references: If the bus arrives on time, I can collect Asha at five-fifteen. The condition matters.
source_meaning: I can pick up Asha at 5:15 if the bus is on time.

source: Phone online sasta hai, lekin delivery mein chaar din lagenge.
target: The online price is lower, but delivery takes four days. Choose which cost matters more.
references: The online price is lower, but delivery takes four days. Choose which cost matters more.
source_meaning: The phone is cheaper online, but delivery takes four days.

source: I will not share your number without asking you first.
target: I will not share your number without asking you first. Access is not permission.
references: I will not share your number without asking you first. Access is not permission.
source_meaning: I will not share your number without asking you first.

source: Maya apna umbrella school gate par chhod gayi.
target: Maya left her umbrella at the school gate. That is where it must be retrieved.
references: Maya left her umbrella at the school gate. That is where it must be retrieved.
source_meaning: Maya left her umbrella at the school gate.

source: We missed the earlier bus because the driver left five minutes early.
target: We missed the earlier bus because the driver left five minutes ahead of schedule. The lost time began there.
references: We missed the earlier bus because the driver left five minutes ahead of schedule. The lost time began there.
source_meaning: We missed the earlier bus because the driver left five minutes early.

source: Main 500 rupees udhaar de sakta hoon, lekin Friday tak wapas chahiye.
target: I can lend you five hundred rupees, but I require it back by Friday. The terms are clear.
references: I can lend you five hundred rupees, but I require it back by Friday. The terms are clear.
source_meaning: I can lend you 500 rupees, but I need it back by Friday.

source: If you have not booked the tickets, don't pay the seller yet.
target: If the tickets are not booked, do not pay the seller yet. Do not pay for what is not secured.
references: If the tickets are not booked, do not pay the seller yet. Do not pay for what is not secured.
source_meaning: If you have not booked the tickets, don't pay the seller yet.

source: Mujhe chai bina sugar pasand hai, thandi ho tab bhi.
target: I prefer tea without sugar, even when it is cold. Some choices do not change with circumstance.
references: I prefer tea without sugar, even when it is cold. Some choices do not change with circumstance.
source_meaning: I prefer tea without sugar, even when it is cold.

source: We should buy only what is on the list.
target: Buy what is on the list and nothing beyond it. Discipline begins with small decisions.
references: Buy what is on the list and nothing beyond it. Discipline begins with small decisions.
source_meaning: We should buy only what is on the list.

source: Clinic Sunday ko band hoti hai, isliye Monday ki booking karo.
target: The clinic is closed on Sundays. Arrange the appointment for Monday instead.
references: The clinic is closed on Sundays. Arrange the appointment for Monday instead.
source_meaning: The clinic is closed on Sundays, so book for Monday.

source: I took the wrong exit and reached the old bridge.
target: I took the wrong exit and reached the old bridge. A single turn changed the route.
references: I took the wrong exit and reached the old bridge. A single turn changed the route.
source_meaning: I took the wrong exit and reached the old bridge.

source: Main screenshot le loon, tab tak message delete mat karna.
target: Do not delete the message until I have taken a screenshot. Preserve the evidence first.
references: Do not delete the message until I have taken a screenshot. Preserve the evidence first.
source_meaning: Don't delete the message until I take a screenshot.

source: I will bring the rice if you make the vegetables.
target: I will bring the rice if you prepare the vegetables. Each of us has a part to fulfill.
references: I will bring the rice if you prepare the vegetables. Each of us has a part to fulfill.
source_meaning: I will bring the rice if you make the vegetables.

source: Parcel aaj aaya, lekin ek glass toota hua hai.
target: The parcel arrived today, but one glass is broken. Arrival does not mean the delivery was complete.
references: The parcel arrived today, but one glass is broken. Arrival does not mean the delivery was complete.
source_meaning: The parcel arrived today, but one glass is broken.

source: I have two exams next week, on Wednesday and Friday.
target: There are two exams next week: Wednesday and Friday. Prepare for both, not merely the nearer one.
references: There are two exams next week: Wednesday and Friday. Prepare for both, not merely the nearer one.
source_meaning: I have two exams next week, on Wednesday and Friday.

source: Shoes return karne pade toh receipt chahiye hogi, use sambhal kar rakhna.
target: Keep the receipt in case the shoes must be returned. Proof is useful when memory is disputed.
references: Keep the receipt in case the shoes must be returned. Proof is useful when memory is disputed.
source_meaning: Please keep the receipt in case we need to return the shoes.

source: I didn't cancel the booking; the hotel changed it.
target: I did not cancel the booking. The hotel changed it. Responsibility must be placed where it belongs.
references: I did not cancel the booking. The hotel changed it. Responsibility must be placed where it belongs.
source_meaning: I didn't cancel the booking; the hotel changed it.

source: Dawai se chakkar aaye toh agli dose se pehle doctor ko call karna.
target: If the medicine causes dizziness, call the doctor before another dose. Do not gamble with uncertainty.
references: If the medicine causes dizziness, call the doctor before another dose. Do not gamble with uncertainty.
source_meaning: If the medicine makes you dizzy, call the doctor before taking another dose.

source: I can meet at the station at 6:40, but I cannot wait past 7.
target: I can meet at the station at six-forty, but I cannot wait beyond seven. The window is limited.
references: I can meet at the station at six-forty, but I cannot wait beyond seven. The window is limited.
source_meaning: I can meet at the station at 6:40, but I cannot wait past 7.

source: Humein teen copies chahiye, har department ke liye ek.
target: Make three copies, one for each department. Each must receive its own record.
references: Make three copies, one for each department. Each must receive its own record.
source_meaning: We need three copies, one for each department.

source: I am grateful you checked on Grandma yesterday.
target: I am grateful that you checked on Grandma yesterday. Such care should not go unnoticed.
references: I am grateful that you checked on Grandma yesterday. Such care should not go unnoticed.
source_meaning: I am grateful you checked on Grandma yesterday.

source: Saturday se pehle Arjun ko surprise plan mat batana.
target: Do not tell Arjun about the surprise before Saturday. Timing is part of the plan.
references: Do not tell Arjun about the surprise before Saturday. Timing is part of the plan.
source_meaning: Don't tell Arjun the surprise plan before Saturday.

source: The internet stopped working after the power cut.
target: The power cut came first; the internet failed afterward. The sequence is clear.
references: The power cut came first; the internet failed afterward. The sequence is clear.
source_meaning: The internet stopped working after the power cut.

source: Main 20 minutes ruk sakta hoon, poori evening nahi.
target: I can stay for twenty minutes, not the entire evening. Know the limit before you make plans.
references: I can stay for twenty minutes, not the entire evening. Know the limit before you make plans.
source_meaning: I can stay for 20 minutes, not the whole evening.

source: Please charge the power bank before we leave at 9.
target: Charge the power bank before we leave at nine. A preventable shortage is still a failure of preparation.
references: Charge the power bank before we leave at nine. A preventable shortage is still a failure of preparation.
source_meaning: Please charge the power bank before we leave at 9.

source: Refund nahi mila, halanki app keh raha hai ki process ho gaya.
target: The app says the refund was processed, yet I have received nothing. The claim must be verified against reality.
references: The app says the refund was processed, yet I have received nothing. The claim must be verified against reality.
source_meaning: I have not received the refund, although the app says it was processed.

source: We should leave the spare key with Kavita, not under the mat.
target: Leave the spare key with Kavita, not beneath the mat. Security depends on where trust is placed.
references: Leave the spare key with Kavita, not beneath the mat. Security depends on where trust is placed.
source_meaning: We should leave the spare key with Kavita, not under the mat.

source: Fog ki wajah se train 35 minutes late hui.
target: Fog delayed the train by thirty-five minutes. The schedule yielded to conditions beyond our control.
references: Fog delayed the train by thirty-five minutes. The schedule yielded to conditions beyond our control.
source_meaning: The train was delayed by 35 minutes because of fog.

source: I will send the file after I remove the customer details.
target: I will send the file after removing the customer details. Private information must not travel with it.
references: I will send the file after removing the customer details. Private information must not travel with it.
source_meaning: I will send the file after I remove the customer details.

source: Main drive kar raha hoon aur Tara ka call aaye, toh use text karna ki main baad mein call karunga.
target: If Tara calls while I am driving, text her that I will call later. Safety takes priority over immediacy.
references: If Tara calls while I am driving, text her that I will call later. Safety takes priority over immediacy.
source_meaning: If Tara calls while I am driving, please text her that I will call later.

source: I need the smaller bag because the larger one will not fit under the seat.
target: The smaller bag is necessary; the larger one will not fit beneath the seat. Size decides the choice.
references: The smaller bag is necessary; the larger one will not fit beneath the seat. Size decides the choice.
source_meaning: I need the smaller bag because the larger one will not fit under the seat.

source: Breakfast ke liye doodh kaafi hai, lekin cake ke liye nahi.
target: There is enough milk for breakfast, but not enough for the cake. Plan according to what exists.
references: There is enough milk for breakfast, but not enough for the cake. Plan according to what exists.
source_meaning: We have enough milk for breakfast, but not enough for the cake.

source: I forgot to lock the back door, so please check it now.
target: I forgot to lock the back door. Check it now; a mistake should be corrected as soon as it is found.
references: I forgot to lock the back door. Check it now; a mistake should be corrected as soon as it is found.
source_meaning: I forgot to lock the back door, so please check it now.

source: School bus 7:10 par aati hai, 7:30 par nahi.
target: The school bus arrives at seven-ten, not seven-thirty. Ten minutes can change the entire morning.
references: The school bus arrives at seven-ten, not seven-thirty. Ten minutes can change the entire morning.
source_meaning: The school bus comes at 7:10, not 7:30.

source: I will join the call, unless my appointment runs late.
target: I will join the call unless my appointment runs late. The commitment stands, subject to that condition.
references: I will join the call unless my appointment runs late. The commitment stands, subject to that condition.
source_meaning: I will join the call, unless my appointment runs late.

source: Monday ko bheje message ka kisi ne reply nahi diya.
target: No one has replied to Monday's message. The silence is a fact; its reason remains unknown.
references: No one has replied to Monday's message. The silence is a fact; its reason remains unknown.
source_meaning: No one has replied to the message I sent on Monday.

source: Please put the frozen peas in the freezer, not the fridge.
target: Put the frozen peas in the freezer, not the fridge. Place each thing where it belongs.
references: Put the frozen peas in the freezer, not the fridge. Place each thing where it belongs.
source_meaning: Please put the frozen peas in the freezer, not the fridge.

source: Shirt exchange tabhi hogi jab tag abhi bhi laga ho.
target: The shirt can be exchanged only while its tag remains attached. Keep the condition intact.
references: The shirt can be exchanged only while its tag remains attached. Keep the condition intact.
source_meaning: I can exchange the shirt only if the tag is still attached.

source: We arrived early, but the museum had not opened yet.
target: We arrived early, yet the museum had not opened. Our timing was sound; the doors were not ready.
references: We arrived early, yet the museum had not opened. Our timing was sound; the doors were not ready.
source_meaning: We arrived early, but the museum had not opened yet.

source: Van book kar do toh main Sunday ko shifting mein help kar sakta hoon.
target: I can help you move on Sunday, provided the van is booked. Make the arrangement, and I will do my part.
references: I can help you move on Sunday, provided the van is booked. Make the arrangement, and I will do my part.
source_meaning: I can help you move on Sunday, provided you book the van.

source: The bill includes delivery, so do not pay an extra fee.
target: Delivery is already included in the bill. Do not pay an additional fee for the same service.
references: Delivery is already included in the bill. Do not pay an additional fee for the same service.
source_meaning: The bill includes delivery, so do not pay an extra fee.

source: Main library ki book kal subah return karunga.
target: I will return the library book tomorrow morning. The obligation has a time, and I will honor it.
references: I will return the library book tomorrow morning. The obligation has a time, and I will honor it.
source_meaning: I will return the library book tomorrow morning.

source: Don't mix the two orders; one is for Nikhil and one is for Rupa.
target: Keep the two orders separate: one belongs to Nikhil, the other to Rupa. Confusion serves no one.
references: Keep the two orders separate: one belongs to Nikhil, the other to Rupa. Confusion serves no one.
source_meaning: Don't mix the two orders; one is for Nikhil and one is for Rupa.

source: Recipe mein 250 grams flour chahiye, 500 nahi.
target: The recipe calls for 250 grams of flour, not 500. Doubling an ingredient changes the result.
references: The recipe calls for 250 grams of flour, not 500. Doubling an ingredient changes the result.
source_meaning: The recipe needs 250 grams of flour, not 500.

source: I won't approve the expense until I see the original receipt.

source: Lift abhi bhi kharab hai toh stairs se third floor tak jao.
target: If the lift remains broken, take the stairs to the third floor. Choose the available route.
references: If the lift remains broken, take the stairs to the third floor. Choose the available route.
source_meaning: If the lift is still broken, use the stairs to the third floor.
